== Trivia ==
* As a crossover to Warhammer 40,000 (abbreviated as WH40k), there are couple nods to the original source material, specificially to the Cadians, a type of Imperial Guard regiment based on the destroyed Fortress World of Cadia.
** The {{PAGENAME}}'s appearance is based on the [https://megalodon.jp/2026-1105-2205-52/https://warhammer40k.wiki.gg:443/wiki/Kasrkin Cadian Kasrkin Killteam], specifically the [https://megalodon.jp/2026-1105-2152-12/https://warhammer40k.wiki.gg:443/wiki/File:KasrkinGunner.jpg Demo-Trooper Model].
** Its color scheme and armor number is a nod to the [https://megalodon.jp/2026-1106-0003-58/https://warhammer40k.wiki.gg:443/wiki/Cadian_122nd Cadian 122nd]<ref>{{cite discord
 | url         = https://discord.com/channels/1102970375731691612/1102973812179488798/1532412049139826880
 | message     = It's because we decided to base the second armor on the Cadian 122nd regiments colors, as seen on and in the City Fight-book from 3rd edition
 | access_date = 31 July
 | author      = lando_viggo
 | channel     = hd2-general-chat-1
}}</ref>, which is featured on the cover and in [https://megalodon.jp/2026-1105-2157-52/https://warhammer40k.wiki.gg:443/wiki/Codex:_Cityfight Cityfight], a 3rd Edition Supplement book revolving around Urban Warfare.
*The symbol on the right shoulder pauldron is that of the Cadian Gate, denoting a large area around [https://megalodon.jp/2026-1105-2154-43/https://warhammer40k.wiki.gg:443/wiki/Cadia Cadia]. The symbol is commonly used as an "honorific badge", showing the Cadian [https://megalodon.jp/2026-1106-0003-46/https://warhammer40k.wiki.gg:443/wiki/Guardsman Guardsman] wearing it fought on Cadia during the time of the [https://megalodon.jp/2026-1106-0003-57/https://warhammer40k.wiki.gg:443/wiki/Black_Crusade Black Crusades].
* The "STC" in the armor's description is a reference to Warhammer 40,000's [https://megalodon.jp/2026-1106-0003-52/https://warhammer40k.wiki.gg:443/wiki/Standard_Template_Construct Standard Template Constructs], highly advanced automated factories that have been lost to time.

Oxygenator.wikitext:
{{Infobox Armor Passive |title={{PAGENAME}} |image={{PAGENAME}} Armor Passive Icon.svg |description=Increases the wearer's walking speed and running speed.
Increases the speed and duration of slides. |order=27 }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Armor Passive|armor passive]] in ''[[Helldivers 2]]''. == Description == {{Armor Passive Info Panel|{{PAGENAME}}}} == Explanation == '''1.''' The wearer walks and runs 10% faster. The speed increase does not apply when prone, crouching or aiming down sights. To calculate your new speed, use this formula: Effective Speed = Armor Speed * 1.1 '''2.''' The wearer slides faster and for ~160ms longer. This results in a 50% increase in slide distance, a 1 meter increase. === Notes === * The 10% speed boost is equal to that of the [[Experimental Infusion]] booster. * The speed boost is roughly equivalent to an armor with 50 less [[Armor#Armor_Stats|Armor Rating]], but lacking the increased stamina a lower Armor Rating armor provides. * The slide distance increase allows for "slide-reloading" of most [[Equipment_Traits#Stationary_Reload|stationary reload]] weapons, such as the [[AC-8 Autocannon]].[https://youtu.be/kbyq4fnEvCA Helldivers 2 Oxygenator Armor Passive: Slide Reloads] * There is no penalty to sliding through [[Blizzards]] and [[Sandstorms]]. It is also possible to slide through shallow water that would prevent a [[Helldiver]] from diving. * Sliding is slower than running and costs stamina in a similar manner to using melee weapons, such as the [[CQC-30 Stun Baton]]. For this reason, spam-sliding is not advised. * Like other armors with different speeds, this armor passive affects Helldivers' movement speed on the Super Destroyer. == Armor List == {{Armors With Passive Table|{{PAGENAME}}}} == Change History == {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.006.202|changes= '''Addition''' * Added with the release of [[Exo Experts Premium Warbond|Exo Experts]]. }} {{Change History Update|date=2026-04-21|1.006.102|changes= Announced [https://blog.playstation.com/2026/04/21/helldivers-2-the-exo-experts-warbond-drops-april-28/ Mitchell Ayre | PlayStation Blog] [https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/553850/view/623327006824596290 | HELLDIVERS™ 2 | Steam] }} == References == {{Nav Armor}}
